# @alt-point/active-models

> Reactive, self-validating DTO models built on Proxy and legacy TypeScript decorators (ActiveModel + @ActiveField). Fields support validators, setters/getters, readonly/hidden/protected/fillable, nested factories, events, dirty tracking and mapping.

Start with the agent guide: it lists the rules that prevent the most bugs (always `Model.create()`, never `new Model()`).

- [Agent guide (AGENTS.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alt-point/active-models/master/AGENTS.md): API cheat sheet, rules, events, migration
- [Decorators example](https://alt-point.github.io/active-models/en/active-model-with-decorators): basic workflow
- [@ActiveField() options](https://alt-point.github.io/active-models/en/active-field-options): every option
- [Model lifecycle](https://alt-point.github.io/active-models/en/model-lifecycle): creation/set/delete flows and events
- [Advanced features](https://alt-point.github.io/active-models/en/active-model-advanced): validators, hooks, create vs new vs fill, clone, makeFreeze
- [Change tracking](https://alt-point.github.io/active-models/en/dirty-tracking): isTouched() with Vue/React
- [Model mapping](https://alt-point.github.io/active-models/en/mapping): mapTo()/hasMapping()
- [ActiveCollection](https://alt-point.github.io/active-models/en/collections): a typed, optionally sorted array
- [Integrity](https://alt-point.github.io/active-models/en/integrity): invariants, transactions, changes()/revert(), undo/redo
- [Validation](https://alt-point.github.io/active-models/en/validation): rules, coercion, normalizers, validate(), transitions, strict mode
- [Known limitations](https://alt-point.github.io/active-models/en/limitations)
- [Migrating to 4.0](https://alt-point.github.io/active-models/en/migration)
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alt-point/active-models/master/CHANGELOG.md)
